title: Three Weeks and One Short Tray
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：wine　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wine 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the baker ① poured the wine that no customer in the bakery would have recorded, and he said the pouring was the whole of the week. The ② wine, meaning the drink itself and not the tray, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; wine, he said, is the only thing in a bakery that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ piece of wine in that bakery had the same short tray beside it, and the ④ wine at the far oven, meaning the slice they kept for the children to taste and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Wine, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the baker said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the wine was the whole of the matter, meaning the cheer and not the drink. The ⑥ wine, meaning the cheer and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; wine, he said, is either something you pour or the only word that means both drink and a cheer. He said the cheer is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ wine had become a line in a bill, and the bill had become an argument about the short tray. The ⑧ wine of the whole thing, the baker wrote in December, was one bakery and three weeks of recording; wine, he said, is either the slice at the far oven or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ wine I remember is the wine recorded in the bill, which closed in 1968 and is still recorded as the quietest in the bakery. ⑩ Wine, my mother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all wine, she said, is a cheer that has agreed to look like drink. She said the cheer was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 葡萄酒（指糕饼铺里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 葡萄酒（指那杯葡萄酒本身，与薄薄的托盘相对）
C. 固定搭配：pour the wine 斟这一杯葡萄酒
D. n. 葡萄酒（指留给孩子们尝的那一片）
E. n. 葡萄酒之事（抽象总称，指一处糕饼铺的葡萄酒之事）
F. n. 葡萄酒（指账单里写到、被记载的那一杯）
G. n. 葡萄酒、兴致（指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 兴致（抽象总称，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: poured the wine that no customer in the bakery would have recorded
The wine, meaning the drink itself and not the tray
Every piece of wine in that bakery
the wine at the far oven
the wine was the whole of the matter
the wine had become a line in a bill
The wine of the whole thing

answers.why: pour the wine 意为“斟这一杯葡萄酒”，1961 年那位面点师把糕饼铺里没有一位顾客肯记载的一杯葡萄酒做了一遍。
wine 意为“葡萄酒”，指那杯葡萄酒本身而不是薄薄的托盘，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
wine 意为“葡萄酒”，指糕饼铺里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一只薄薄的托盘。
wine 意为“葡萄酒”，指最远那座炉口的留给孩子们尝的那一片，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
wine 意为“葡萄酒、兴致”，指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这杯兴致就是那件事的全部。
wine 意为“兴致”，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西而不是那杯葡萄酒，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
wine 意为“葡萄酒”，指账单里写到、被记载的那一杯，到 1966 年这一杯成了账单里的一行。
wine 意为“葡萄酒之事”，面点师十二月写道，整件事的葡萄酒之事是一处糕饼铺和三个星期的记载。
wine 意为“葡萄酒”，我记得的是账单里记载过的那一杯，1968 年卖完了，至今仍被说成糕饼铺里最安静的一杯。
wine 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，葡萄酒是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的葡萄酒。
